subject: 华山路823、825、827号院临街住宅西南侧突出窗间、屋檐与三山墙瓦顶
layout_units: author coordinates multiplied by 0.683 to obtain metres
side_setback_and_z: The 2015-12-18 and 2020-02-21 files show the same two projecting south bays. The lower openings run behind a hedge. Their visible top is traced, while the sill and room depth are uncertain.

The red-brown main roof runs northeast to southwest. The aerial views distinguish three short transverse ridges towards the northwest street. Tile counts, invisible rear openings and room layout are outside the photographic control.

The windows and caps on the projecting low section remain separate from the high gable return. The inferred rear slope closes at the southeast eave. Field observations constrain the near eave, length and vented chimney more tightly than the interior valleys.

The shared scale 0.683 m per author unit preserves the root model. Its 5.50-unit wing setback is 3.7565 m. The identifiable front peaks yield 2.57 m in the joint solution, 3.42 m in 2015 and 2.61 m in 2020. The first eight-view solution yielded 3.81 m with the corner mislabelled in two views. Treat 2.6–3.8 m as the supported depth range.
